thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Executive Summary: </paragraph><paragraph>I used Perplexity Pro to solve the Coding Questions of Homework 3. In general Perplexity was quick and accurate, although at times it did seem to produce insufficient answers. Notably it did not hallucinate incorrect answers, but instead simply failed to achieve complete correctness. Additionally, it required some prodding and massaging to get answers in a form that was acceptable, with multiple times requiring follow up prompting. Nevertheless, Perplexity did one-shot nearly all of the questions and performed excellently on the problems presented. Executive Summary: 

I used Perplexity Pro to solve the Coding Questions of Homework 3. In general Perplexity was quick and accurate, although at times it did seem to produce insufficient answers. Notably it did not hallucinate incorrect answers, but instead simply failed to achieve complete correctness. Additionally, it required some prodding and massaging to get answers in a form that was acceptable, with multiple times requiring follow up prompting. Nevertheless, Perplexity did one-shot nearly all of the questions and performed excellently on the problems presented. My Annotated Conversation can be found here:
